title: Reachy Robot Companion Notice
what_changed: First version of the notice for the optional Reachy Mini robot.

sections.heading: 1. What Reachy does, and does not do

blocks.text: At medication time, Reachy reminds you, looks for you, asks you to take each medicine, and observes you taking it. If you switch on check-ins, it then has a short conversation with you.

Reachy **observes hand-to-mouth movement. It cannot identify which pill you took or how many.** Some records are therefore marked "observed, pill not verified", and some are sent to a family member to confirm.

Reachy is not a doctor, counsellor, or emergency service, and cannot call emergency services. **In an emergency call 119.** If you are thinking about harming yourself, call **1925** (24 hours, free), **1995**, or **1980**.

items: Camera images at medication time: **analysed in memory and never saved.** People other than you are not identified.

With check-ins on: your voice is turned into text **on the robot itself**; the audio never leaves your home and is never stored. We keep the text transcripts, summaries, conversation mood, and safety flags.

sections.heading: 3. Where it is processed, by whom, and for how long

rows: Camera analysis, speech-to-text and Reachy's voice
The Reachy robot and the home server run by {OPERATOR_NAME}
Conversation text, used to write Reachy's replies
Conversation text, used for summaries and safety screening

blocks.text: No audio leaves your home: speech is converted to text on the robot, and we never store recordings. Only the text of the conversation is sent to {LLM_SERVICE} and {LLM_PROVIDER}, under the retention terms above.

items: You: everything, including full transcripts for 30 days.

Family contacts you verify: daily check-in summaries **only if you switch sharing on for that person** (topics and mood, never the full conversation), requests to confirm doses, and safety alerts (section 6).

rows: Words quoted in a safety alert
Until you delete them or your account
Camera images; audio on our server

blocks.text: If a check-in suggests you may be at **serious risk of harming yourself**, or that you may have **taken too much medicine** (even by accident), Reachy will give you help-line numbers and **all your verified family contacts will be alerted immediately, with the specific words that raised concern, even if you turned other alerts off.**

Alerts repeat until a family member responds. If you withdraw consent while an alert is active, that alert still continues until someone responds. Check-ins are only available with safety alerts on. Automated detection can miss things and can raise false alarms.

sections.heading: 7. Medicine you say you took, or that Reachy could not verify

blocks.text: The dose is marked "waiting for confirmation" and a family member is asked to check the pill box. This helps prevent taking the same dose twice.
You can withdraw each Reachy consent at any time in Settings. The robot stops within seconds, and you can choose to delete your transcripts and summaries at the same time.
